content: Abade irisimide mirumiri wae yaenu narakepesa

Gore Juda aanuna rekena agaame orope paliade-anu rayo penaame nawaasa. Goa pua rekena agaare ora yaena re waru namea waasa pare wasupa ademe-rupa mada adesimi. Rekena agaamere maali padane laatapu Gote-para oyaena miru padane-rupa miru ira-mama pu piruasimi. Goa pua oro yaalo onaanu nimu lotu ada-para pisimi rabu rekena agaame nimu namaepea kiritisa.

Dia yapare rekena agaame Gote-na bi minasaatalo pisimi onaanuri nimu waru maredepo yata pisa yaalore gore nimumi Gote-para epe kaa pi miru wala nairita pisimi. Go page miru irua onaanuna kedaa dia ta pisa yaalore nimumi miru irae kogono gimoa waea nasaapirita pisimi.
Goa pisimi pare oro yaalo maali epala pisa rabu mo nimuna miru irisimi rabu nimuna wae yaenu pa niminaaba pirua gona irisimi.
Goa pea-ga gawa mena yadapuna yaapi-para meme menana yaapipara-mere onaanuna wae yaenu ora namea rubisa.
Goa pea-pulu Krais go su amaa epolalo pirisa raburi nipumi Gote-para gupa sa:

content.text: Gore nimumi pa gawa mena-para meme menanuna yaapi koyoa miru irua katemere nimu gimi omesi.
Goa pua neme nina miru iratalo nena yogane aba managola saaye.
Gore nimumi meme gawanuna to yogane rayo aana reke madaa sua repena sulaa-para mea sua miru irua wae yaenu rayo mea rubaasimi.
Neme go kone rayo raaname naomesi.
Abade ni madaa rekena agaa i buk madaa pepa tisimi ya-rupare abiare nena agaa pagoa ratulalo aba epawa sa.

content: Go aba ripiare nipu madaa rekena agaame miru irisimina agaa madaa gupa su: Nimumi meme gawa menanu tua miru iritimiri gore neme gime sa. Goa pua oyae ari go yaenu aana reke madaa repena sulaa-para wae yaenu mea rubenalo miru iritimiri neme go kone madaa raaname page naomesi.

Goa puare wala oropere nipumi gupa sa: Gore neme ni adape. Niri nena agaa pagoa ratulalo aba epawa sa. Goa sa-pulu nimuna abana miru irisimide kogono rayore nipumi mea ruboare Krais niaa madaa omape kogono mea lopasa.
Yesu Krais-mere Gote-na kone rayo mua pisa-pulu nipuna yoganere Gote-na miru irape-rupa rana padane pisa. Goa pisa-pulu go madaare nipumi niaana wae yaenu mea rubainaloa epe-rupa pima.
Krais nipuna to mea kasa rabu ofa-rupa pua wae yaenu rayo mea rubisa
Gote-na miru irae Juda aa rayore reke madaa rekaawa nimuna kogono oro yaalo arinuna miru padane-rupa irisimi. Oro yaalo goa peme pare gomere onaanuna wae yaenu mada namea rubaasa.

Goa pea pare Krais-me niaana wae yaenu mea rubape miru-rupare ora rana padane-ma iraasame epesa. Go madaare oro yaalo go kogonome niaana wae yaenu rayo mea ruba kiritisa. Nipumi goa puare nipu Gote-na popo ki-nane pua pia.
Nipu goa pu kirituare Gote-me nipuna iaanu nipuna aa rolo-para mea mapiraainalo nipu ado pirua surubesa.
Gore nipumi rana padane miru irisaana kogono pua onaanu maepeaawa nimu oro yaalo epe-rupa mapiraatalo pisa.
Go madaare Holi Spirit-mi page niaa agaa gupa laguaaya: Gore Aa Mudumi goa sa:

Go kagaa pogatua pirape yaere go-rupa: Neme nimu raapu pogatapena agaa kagaa gupa laketoa: Nina rekena agaa rayore nimuna lo robaa-para masaalua. Goa pua nimuna kone-para rekena agaa page tu salua sa.
Goa lakeloa sana wala orope agaa meda gupa lakesa: Neme nimuna wae yaenu pisimide kogono madaa naniminaaba piralua sa.
Gore Gote-me wae yaenu aba mea rubaasa-pulu wala niaame wae yae raakepenalo miru wala meda nairalima.
Niaame Gote kone waru rulaawa re-para baina
Goa pea-ga nina ame baaninu, Yesu nipuna yaapimi niaa aba kabesa-pulu Gote-na sogo epe rekena rum-para pua odobatalore gore niaame paalame naomamina.

Nipumi ora epe kagaa pora warisa-pulu niaa mo Gote-na ada-para baina. Go kagaa oro yaalo pirape porare nipu omesa rabu nimumi nipuna yogane mo epe adana mamina pora gaape nona piane maoyaasimi. Goa pisa-daa niaa ora epe ru-nane mada odobamina.
Gore niaana Gote-na miru irae aa mudu padane pia-pulu niaa Gote-na rurunu mapiraaya.

Gore nipumi abade nipuna yaapimi niaana robaa-para i wae kone rayo mea ruboa niaa maepeaasa. Goa pua nipumi niaana yogane page epe ipame aba radepeasa. Goa pisa-pulu niaame kone padane sulalore puri waru paloa kone rulaawa Gote re-para baina.
Goa pua epe oyae gialua ta-pulu niaame kone waru rulaawa ado piramina. Goa pua Gote-me aana oraawa ora palua ta yaenuri ora mada palia.
Goa pua niaame niaana ame baaninu madaa kone waru sua nimu raba meamina. Niaame goa palima rabu nimumi raana omape kone-para epe kogono pape pora agu ratinalo raba meamina.

Goa pua niaana ame baaninu raapu kirita pirape konere nakone rugulamina. Onaa medalomame kone rugulaawa pirisimi-rupa napiramina. Dia, niaame ame baaninuna robaa-para puri mapalamina. Gore niaame Aa Muduna epape diri abiare aba rudu yala-ga nimu ora waru raba meamina.
Niaame Gote-na Siri masaa narilamina
Gore niaame Krais-na agaa aba waru pago kiritua wala orope niaana koneme pupitagi nalima-daare go wae yae mea rubolalore miru irae konemere mada namea rubalia.

Dia-ga niaame paalame ora waru omoa koso lape di madaa kone waru sua paalame omoa piramina. Gore onaa medalomare Gote-na iaanu apo piruaeme-pulu koso pagoare wae yoto minaloa oro yaalo raape repena sulaa-mere nimu rayo ralia.
Gore aa medaloma Moses-na rekena agaa rasisimiri adasae aa repo lapome nipuna pisa waenu lakesimi. Goa pisa rabu koso pagoare nimumi go aa madaa odome naomoa nipu tu maomasimi.

Goa pisa pare aa medame Gote-na Si masaa rilalia-daare Gote-me raaname omalia ya? Dia, go aamere ora wae yoto adaape mulalo pea. Yesuna yaapi-miri abade go aa nipu wala misa. Goa pisa pare mo Yesuna yaapimi Gote-na kagaa pogatu pirape yae nipuna puri mapalaasa. Go pisa-pulu Gote-na Holi Spirit-mi rabameape kone guaayare ora waea pea kone imi.
Go agaare Gote-me lagiala-ga pagalepa: Neme waea pi onaanu-para kone sua yago abutua sa. Goa pua nipumi wala agaa gupa sa: Aa Mudumi nipuna ruru onaa koso pago rumaalia sa.
Goa pea-ga aa meda apo-rupa waea paliare oro yaalo pa piri Gote-me wae yaena yago tulalo palia-pulu go madaare paalame waru omamina.
Niaame kone rulae yae madaa rekaamina
Pare nimimi abade pirisimide-rupa niminaatepape. Gore Gote-na epe paa adoa kedaa adaapu risimi rabu go yaenumi nimi narabuaniaasa.

Goa pua yapi medalomamere nimumi nimi pa onaana ini agaana marekaawa ero agaa loa waea pisimi. Goa pua oro medamere onaa medaloma kedaa go-rupa risimi rabu nimimi nimu raba mulalore nimu raapu pua pirisimi.

Goa pua onaa medaloma kalabus ada-para pirisimi rabu nimimi odome omesimi. Goa pua aanumi nimina oyae wala perea meala pisimi rabu nimimi raaname omoa ria mina gimisimi. Gore nimina oro yaalo epe pirape oyaenu ia-daa niminaawa go kedaanu riasimi.
Goa pisa-ga nimina robaa-para i puri pane kone rulae yae nimimi nagimalepape. Dia, go koneme nimi epe yoto adaape mea gialia.
Nimimi puri paloa rekaape kone salepape. Nimimi goa palimi rabu nimimi Gote-na agaa mogeawa Gote-me aana oraawa ora palua ta-pulu epe oyaenu pirua mealimina.
Gore Gote-na buk madaa gupa tu isa: Orope oge-daa pirua epaliade aare ora epalia. Gore nipuri ado piruaaya.
Goa pea pare nina epe redepo ne onaanumi kone rulaawa nimi oro yaalo epe-rupa piralepape. Goa palimi pare nimu padane-mame ni masaa rilalia-daare neme nipu madaa raaname naomalua.
Goa sa pare niaame paalame naomoa pururu piae naloa alupamina. Dia, niaame ora kone waru rulaawa oro yaalo kagaa piraama laama palima.
